retrievalProfile.description: A stylized 1980s airbrushed illustration of a figure in a pastel kitchen, featuring a central circular graphic emblem and geometric floor lines.
excludeWhen: gritty or dark urban themes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, airbrushed domestic scene depicting a person entering or leaving a kitchen through a door, characterized by soft gradients, pastel pink and blue cabinetry, and a bold geometric floor pattern in red, white, and teal.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by an open door against a pastel kitchen backdrop
Circular graphic emblem overlapping the top-center typography
Strong horizontal parallel lines framing the top header
Geometric floor stripes leading the eye into the composition
coreInvariants: Soft airbrushed gradients on all surfaces
Pastel pink cabinetry contrasted with a red countertop edge
Circular red-outlined emblem behind the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure at medium scale, positioned in the doorway between the foreground floor and background kitchen.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular red emblem at the top center serves as the primary focal point for the branding.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the floor stripes upward to the figure, then to the circular emblem and typography at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top corners, balanced by the dense detail of the kitchen on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pastel pink and lavender for cabinetry and walls.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red for the countertop edge, floor stripes, and emblem outline.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal and mint green for floor stripes and decorative kitchen items.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value pastels with medium-saturation accents; soft lighting creates gentle value shifts.

letterConstructionRules: Main title uses a thick, fluid brush script with a slight upward tilt.
Secondary text follows the curve of the circular emblem.
Tertiary text on props uses blocky, geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking descenders in the script title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Fluid script paired with a rigid geometric sans-serif for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, hand-drawn feel of the main title.
Matches the geometric secondary text on the bread box.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a 1950s-style kitchen in pastel pink and lavender, featuring a person in a red shirt in a doorway, with a geometric red and teal floor pattern and a white refrigerator.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large green script title at the top center, overlapping a red circular outline, framed by two black horizontal bars.

verificationChecks: Is the floor pattern geometric and multi-colored?
Is the kitchen rendered with soft airbrush gradients?
Does the title overlap a circular emblem?
Are the colors primarily pastel with red accents?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red countertop edge is a distinct horizontal line.
Verify the circular emblem is centered behind the text.
Check that the floor stripes have a perspective-based zig-zag.
Confirm the airbrushed look is consistent across the fridge and cabinets.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a domestic airbrushed scene with a centered circular graphic header and geometric floor leading lines.
